title: Deliver Water to Slunningville Water Tower
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Water** delivered to **Slunningville Water Tower** (industry id 9, near tile 18,84).

A likely supplier is **Slunningville Water Supply** (industry id 8, near tile 20,67); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **350 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
